notes.title: Second Patch
notes.content:
Thank you for your feedback. Here are the second patch notes.


 Made blocks less transparent
 Lowered "floatiness" of player movement
 Lowered backboard emissions
 Made it so that music and/or sound effects could be turned off

notes.title: First Patch
notes.content:
After recommendations for improvement, here are the following changes.


 Edited UI text in the tutorial level
 Adjusted paddle size 
 Adjusted laser charge rate
 Lowered the minimum for the movement sensitivity
